record_type: Prepared on branch claude/drop-damage-guides; NOT published. Held for owner review and a staged release.
why: Search Console (3 months to 2026-11-15): the site's traffic comes from physical-damage triage (black screen after a drop 870 clicks; protector vs crack, cracked screen safe, back glass, ghost touch) and PS5 hardware. These eight guides extend that pattern to symptoms with visible query demand and no dedicated page. Queries seen include 'phone not turning on after dropping', 'my phone fell and the screen is not working', 'phone screen half black after dropping', 'i dropped my phone and the screen is black with lines', 'dualsense not charging' cluster (controller interest).

not_built.reglass, hairline crack: already sections on existing pages since 2026-11-07

rules: Every manufacturer fact from a page read on 2026-11-21 (fetched text); facts phrased as 'Apple says', 'Sony says'.
No invented bench stories, statistics or prices; owner bench points requested via <!-- bench-note --> comments.
Article schema only (FAQ/HowTo retired); author Person #samuel.
Mail-in CTA stays 'Statewide' (Idaho) until the owner extends it.

guides.topic: No signs of life after a drop: confirm it's really off, one forced restart, an hour on a known-good charger, what a drop can break, stop signs, data check
guides.uniqueness: phone-screen-black-but-on covers a phone that still rings; this page is its 'no signs of life' branch and routes back to it.
guides.bench_question: What dead-after-a-drop phones most often turn out to be on the HDR bench (port, battery, board).

guides.topic: Picture fine, touch dead/patchy/laggy after a drop
guides.uniqueness: ghost-touch covers extra taps; samsung-screen-issues has one line on dead touch; black-but-on has no picture.
guides.bench_question: What dead touch after a drop usually turns out to be (assembly, connector, board), and whether a dead strip ever returns.

guides.topic: Black spot / ink blot / half-black screen after a drop or pressure; why it spreads; screenshot test
guides.uniqueness: Dark counterpart of white-spot-on-phone-screen; lines and fully black screens routed to their pages.
guides.bench_question: How fast black spots tend to spread, in plain words; a real bench photo of an OLED ink blot.

guides.topic: Cracked camera cover glass vs damaged camera module; per-lens photo test; interim protection
guides.uniqueness: iphone-camera-shaking covers shake/click/focus (short glass-vs-module section); this is the cracked-glass page and links there.
guides.bench_question: Which iPhone models allow lens cover glass alone vs back glass/housing; tape advice for an open lens.

guides.topic: No sound / crackle / rattle after a drop; which speaker; mic vs speaker
guides.uniqueness: iphone-speaker-muffled-after-water owns liquid; iphone-not-ringing owns ring-only problems; mic page owns recordings.
guides.bench_question: What a crackly or rattling speaker after a drop usually turns out to be.

guides.topic: DualSense / Edge stick drift: confirm the stick, Sony reset and update, dead zones, warranty, lasting fix
sources: DualSense CFI-ZCT1W and DualSense Edge manual PDFs (playstation.com)
guides.uniqueness: switch-joycon-drift is Nintendo; ps5-controller-not-charging is power. Hall-effect/TMR offer restated from ps5-repair.html, no price.
guides.bench_question: One stick or both, which side; replace one stick or both. Also: Joy-Con page recommends compressed air/isopropyl, Sony says keep liquids out — owner to decide house advice.

guides.topic: DualSense won't pair / disconnects: USB + PS button, data cable, reset, updates, interference, PC/phone pairing, hardware signs
guides.uniqueness: ps5-controller-not-charging owns charging/no light; nothing on the site covered pairing.
guides.bench_question: What 'won't connect' controllers usually turn out to be: pairing, USB-C port, battery or board.

guides.topic: Lines, ink, cracks or flicker on a laptop screen after a drop; external display, screenshot and lid-angle tests
guides.uniqueness: laptop-screen-black-but-running owns no-picture and the full external-monitor procedure; hinge and stage-light pages routed.
guides.bench_question: Panel-only vs full lid assembly on dropped laptops; tape advice for loose glass. (Dell/HP/Lenovo self-test pages blocked automated reading, so brand BIST steps were left out.)
